categories.main_business_segments: Sichuan Kexin Mechanical and Electrical Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing of heavy-duty pressure vessel process equipment and system integration. Its main business covers design, research, and manufacturing of reactors, heat exchangers, towers, and containers for industries such as nuclear power, military, new energy, new materials, natural gas chemical, petroleum refining, and coal chemical sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including multi-layer clamping, large thin-walled complex component forming, large spherical tank segment pressing, CNC bending, and specialized welding techniques for various steel types and special alloys. It holds multiple certifications including ASME U and U2 stamps and nuclear safety manufacturing licenses. The production process is order-driven, with design and manufacturing strictly following national and international standards, including ASME and nuclear industry requirements.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large enterprises in downstream sectors such as petrochemical, natural gas chemical, coal chemical, nuclear power, new energy, and new materials industries. The company has established long-term strategic partnerships with major domestic clients like CNPC, Sinopec, CNOOC, China General Nuclear Power Group, and international technology suppliers such as KBR, Stamicarbon, Mitsubishi, MAN, and others.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Sichuan Province, China, with operations primarily serving the domestic market, which accounts for over 98% of sales. It also exports products internationally, though foreign sales constitute a small portion of total revenue. The company benefits from its location in Deyang, a major equipment manufacturing base in western China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sichuan Kexin operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and system integrator of specialized pressure vessel equipment. It procures raw materials such as stainless steel, carbon steel, composite materials, and special alloys from qualified suppliers and delivers finished equipment directly to end customers in energy and chemical industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation and R&D investment, focusing on developing high-end, large-scale, and specialized pressure vessels with enhanced performance for high-pressure, corrosion-resistant, and extreme temperature applications. It actively pursues breakthroughs in nuclear fuel transport containers, hydrogen energy equipment, and special materials. Digital transformation, intelligent manufacturing, and lean management are strategic priorities to improve production efficiency and product quality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized pressure vessel products based on customer orders. The company follows an order-driven production model with payment terms structured around prepayments, progress payments, delivery payments, and quality assurance deposits. It also earns income from related services such as design and after-sales support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a fragmented domestic and international market dominated by established players from the US, Europe, Japan, Korea, and India. Sichuan Kexin is positioned as a leading domestic high-end pressure vessel manufacturer with strong technical capabilities, comprehensive certifications, and a growing market share. It is recognized as one of the few listed companies in the sector with significant influence and brand reputation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.22 billion, a decrease of 18.79% from the previous year, but net profit attributable to shareholders increased by 3.54% to RMB 169.29 million. The company maintains a solid asset base of over RMB 2.35 billion and continues to invest in R&D with expenditures around RMB 41.7 million, representing 3.43% of revenue. Cash flow from operations improved significantly, indicating enhanced operational efficiency despite market challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sichuan Kexin differentiates itself through its comprehensive qualifications, advanced manufacturing technologies, and ability to produce large, complex, and high-specification pressure vessels including nuclear and military-grade equipment. Its strong R&D capabilities, proprietary technologies, and close collaboration with top academic and research institutions enable it to deliver high-quality, reliable, and customized solutions that meet stringent safety and environmental standards. The company emphasizes safety, quality, delivery, and cost control as core values to provide superior customer satisfaction.
